definitions.explanation: The act of replacing one thing with another, or exchanging items. The noun form of the verb 取り換える (to replace, to exchange).

examples.japanese: ⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{換|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{換|か}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦レシート→レシート：05291_reshiito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: A receipt is required for product exchanges.

examples.japanese: ⟦フィルター→フィルター：21847_firutaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{換|か}え⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check when the filter is due for replacement.

notes:
The noun form of {取|と}り{換|か}える (to replace, to exchange). Refers to the act of swapping one thing for another, whether replacing a worn-out item or exchanging goods.

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {取替|とりかえ}え. The kanji {換|か} and {替|か} are largely interchangeable here.

COMPOUNDS:
- {取|と}り{換|か}え⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: replacement timing
- {取|と}り{換|か}え⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: replacement work/construction
- {取|と}り{換|か}え⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for replacement

USAGE:
The verb form {取|と}り{換|か}える is more common in everyday speech. The noun form appears often in written instructions, product descriptions, and signs.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧: exchange (more formal, also used for mutual exchange)
- ⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}え→入れ替え：21232_irekae⟧: switching out, rotation (e.g., staff rotation)
